Title: Add Dockerfiles and docker-compose for local and cluster deployment

Description:
Containerize services (API and frontends) and provide a `docker-compose.yml` for local development and easy cluster deployment references.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Dockerfiles for API and frontends added.
- `docker-compose.yml` starts API and one frontend for local testing.
- README updated with `yarn && docker-compose up` instructions.

Labels: enhancement
